instruction: please let's make sure to delete this VM image and reclaim that space once we're done!
preserve: unrelated VMs, images, caches and personal files
procedure: Resolve exact actual paths and ownership from acquisition and VM receipts.
Stop any owned running VM and check that no retained dependent clone uses the base.
Remove the owned clones and base/cache files using their exact resolved targets.
Measure task-allocated bytes and filesystem free bytes before/after; APFS shared blocks mean logical image size is not guaranteed reclaimed space.
Report removals and reclaimed space to the user.
scope: only experiment-owned VM clones, the pinned downloaded base image, and associated large experiment image caches beneath /private/tmp/taskflow-e06-vm-a
when: after the E06 experiment is finished, not at the acquisition checkpoint
